# Sound effects

16 sound effects, synthesized by FFmpeg, so no audio files are needed. With Claude, use `add_sound_effect` with timeline times (`align: "end"` makes a sound finish at the time, for risers), or `beat_sync` with `sound` to add one on every beat. Each effect is rendered once to a WAV file in the session's output folder and added as an `sfx` audio clip.

Definitions live in [src/library/sound-effects/index.ts](../../src/library/sound-effects/index.ts). Register your own with `registerSoundEffect`.

| id | Name | Category | Length | Params | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `whoosh` | Whoosh | transition | 0.8s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Airy whoosh that swells and fades. Put it on a cut, a slide or zoom transition, or a title flying in; start it slightly before the cut. |
| `swoosh` | Swoosh / Swipe | transition | 0.35s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Short, bright swipe for fast cuts, sliding text and UI motion. |
| `riser` | Riser | transition | 2s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Rising tone and noise that builds tension up to a reveal or drop. End it exactly on the moment it leads to. |
| `glitch` | Glitch | transition | 0.5s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Digital stutter and crunch for glitch transitions and tech looks. |
| `impact` | Impact / Boom | impact | 1.5s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Deep cinematic boom: title reveals, big moments, the first frame of a trailer. Pair with impactShake or flashHits. |
| `hit` | Hit / Punch | impact | 0.35s |  | Short punchy hit for zoom punches, cuts on the beat and emphasis on a word. |
| `bassDrop` | Bass Drop | impact | 2s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Falling sub-bass sweep, for drops and dramatic turns. |
| `pop` | Pop | ui | 0.15s |  | Bubbly pop for text, stickers, emoji or captions appearing. |
| `click` | Click | ui | 0.04s |  | Crisp click for buttons, cursor moves and list items. |
| `notification` | Notification | ui | 0.35s |  | Two-tone notification blip (messages, alerts, new item). |
| `error` | Error Buzz | ui | 0.42s |  | Low double buzz for mistakes, fails and wrong answers. |
| `typing` | Typing | ui | 1.5s | `duration` (Length in seconds) | Keyboard typing clicks, for text typing on screen. |
| `ding` | Ding | musical | 1.5s | `pitch` (Bell frequency in Hz) | Bright bell ding: a correct answer, a tip, a highlight or a list item. |
| `success` | Success Chime | musical | 1.2s |  | Rising three-note chime for wins, completions and reveals. |
| `shutter` | Camera Shutter | foley | 0.25s |  | Camera shutter click, for freeze frames, photos and snapshots. |
| `heartbeat` | Heartbeat | foley | 0.8s |  | One lub-dub heartbeat. Repeat it for tension; pairs with the heartbeat video effect. |
